![](images/0.jpg) TERRIFYING AND RELENTLESS SHOCK TROOPS CRAFTED FROM TORTURED FLESH, FLESHBORN HYBRIDS ROAM BATTLEFIELDS WITH A MINDLESS DETERMINATION TO DESTROY. SWATHED IN SINEW AND CONNECTED BY GROTESQUE STAPLES, THESE ABOMINATIONS EMIT A FOUL STENCH OF DECAY AND OOZE. DRIVEN BY PRIMAL INSTINCTS, THEIR RAVENOUS MAWS AND LASHING TENTACLES MAKE THEM FORMIDABLE OPPONENTS. Armor Class : 13 Hit Points: 45 Hit Dice : 6d8+18 Speed: walk : 30

Saving Throws : str : 0, dex : 0, wis : 0 Skills : perception : 2 Resistances : Senses : darkvision : 60 Languages : Understands Abyssal, can't speak Challenge Rating : 3 (700) ## ACTIONS Claw : The Fleshborn Hybrid makes a melee weapon attack with its claws. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8+3 slashing damage. Bite : The Fleshborn Hybrid makes a melee weapon attack with its bite. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2d6+3 necrotic damage. Flesh Lash (Recharge 5-6) : The Fleshborn Hybrid lashes out with three tongue-tentacles at up to three targets within 15 ft. +5 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 2d6+3 psychic damage. Targets are grappled (escape DC 15). Multiatack : 'The Fleshborn Hybrid makes two attacks: one with its claw and one with its bite. Consume the Weak : 'If the Fleshborn Hybrid is within reach of a grappled, incapacitated, or unconscious creature, it devours the creature's flesh. This attack automatically hits, dealing 4d6 necrotic damage to the target.
